subject.title: Tool result channel becomes empty after several calls on 2026.7.1-beta.1

question: Should the canonical fix for this issue prioritize current fresh non-trailing tool output over older frozen projected tool-result history when aggregate prompt recovery cannot keep both?
rationale: The bug is valid, but the proposed fix intentionally changes saturated-session context priority and should be an explicit maintainer tradeoff before the linked PR lands.

options.title: Accept fresh-output priority
options.body: Land the linked PR after maintainer review and close this issue once the fix is on main with provenance.

options.title: Require installed-session proof
options.body: Hold the linked PR until a redacted long-lived installed-session run demonstrates the non-trailing fresh-result recovery path outside the helper harness.

recommendation.title: Accept fresh-output priority
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR after maintainer review and close this issue once the fix is on main with provenance.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the adjacent same-helper protection for trailing fresh tool results, so they are the best available owner for the fresh-output priority tradeoff.
